results.reasoning: Driven in a terminal with the working tree's bin/walkdown.js on throwaway HOME and WALKDOWN_HOME machines; nothing was served, so no port was used. The five steps hold, in a terminal through expect and without one. n-0554 is fixed: the kept home's path from inside an unrelated clone at ~/shop is refused with the registry unchanged, and typing --project shop still vouches. Round 22's other arrangements hold: re-clone then set-url, amend and gc then mv, 7997eae rows rewritten in place or moved then renamed, v0.3.0 rows upgraded then re-cloned and renamed, and exFAT inode reuse. The kept home's default label still reaches the move test, which skips every fact once a project is named. After billing is forgotten and ~/shop deleted, importing billing's kept path from inside an unrelated repository moves shop's cart ID there. Imported by its own path, the same repository gets a new project. walkdown at 9310e22 does the same, so this is older than the fix; filed as n-0555.
